description: This PHP source file defines the PimReportDataAPI class, which extends the ReportDataAPI class to provide API endpoints related to PIM (Personal Information Management) reports within the OrangeHRM system. It manages report retrieval, parameter validation, and integration with the ReportGeneratorService.

classes.name: PimReportDataAPI
classes.description: A class extending ReportDataAPI to handle PIM report data retrieval and validation, integrating with report services and handling API request validation, specific to PIM reports in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Returns an instance of ReportGeneratorService, initializing it if not already instantiated.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves the report object based on the report name and ID from the request parameters; throws BadRequestException if the report name is invalid.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' API request, including report name and ID validation.
